lines.en: label harukadate1:
Maybe I’ll see what Haruka is up to?
lines.zh: 要不我去看看 Haruka 在干什么？

lines.en: Now that I think about it, the two of us haven’t really hung out except for that one time she gave me a ride home.
lines.zh: 现在想想，除了那次她开车送我回家，我们俩其实没怎么一起玩过。

lines.en: And even then it was more along the lines of just...getting to her house and leaving a few minutes later.
lines.zh: 而且那次也基本上是……到了她家，几分钟后就走了。

lines.en: Besides, she wouldn’t have given me her number if she didn’t want to actually talk, right?
lines.zh: 再说了，如果她不是真的想聊，也不会把号码给我吧？

lines.en: Not knowing what else to do, I tap on Haruka’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 不知道还能做什么，我点开手机上 Haruka 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hey, it’s-
lines.zh: : 嘿，我是——

lines.en: : I know who it is. I've had your name in my phone since I asked you to check on Rin for me.
lines.zh: : 我知道是谁。从那次我让你去帮我看看 Rin 开始，我手机里就有你的名字了。

lines.en: : And you haven't bothered calling? Do you even like me?
lines.zh: : 那你一直没打过？你到底喜不喜欢我？

lines.en: : Hey, you haven't called either!
lines.zh: : 喂，你也没打过啊！

lines.en: : Is everything okay, though? Is this about Rin again? Because she seemed fine earlier today and-
lines.zh: : 不过，一切都还好吗？又是关于 Rin 的事吗？因为她今天早些时候看起来挺好的，而且——

lines.en: : Everything is fine. I was just wondering what you were doing tonight.
lines.zh: : 一切都好。我只是想知道你今晚在做什么。

lines.en: : Tonight? I was going to hang out at Sara’s bar.
lines.zh: : 今晚？我本来打算去 Sara 的酒吧待着。

lines.en: : Do you...want to come or something?
lines.zh: : 你……想过来吗？还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Sure. If you guys are cool with having me.
lines.zh: : 好啊。只要你们不介意我加入。

lines.en: : I'm sure we are, but let me check anyway! Hold on a sec.
lines.zh: : 我肯定不介意，不过我还是问一下吧！等一下哈。

lines.en: A moment of silence passes by as Haruka does...whatever.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默过去，Haruka 在做……随便什么。

lines.en: : Sara says you're free to come so long as you spend a lot of money.
lines.zh: : Sara 说你可以来，前提是你得花很多钱。

lines.en: : What if I just come, spend a normal amount of money, and keep you company?
lines.zh: : 那要是我过去，只花正常数目的钱，然后陪着你呢？

lines.en: : Hmm...well, I {i}do{/i} seem like the loneliest person at the bar...
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧，我看起来{i}确实{/i}是酒吧里最孤单的那个人……

lines.en: : You’re probably the only customer at the bar in general.
lines.zh: : 你大概就是这家酒吧唯一的客人吧。

lines.en: : Also correct. So, are you going to come over now, or?...
lines.zh: : 这也说对了。那么，你现在过来吗？还是？……

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m on my way. Don't get too drunk without me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我这就过去。别在我到之前喝太醉。

lines.en: : What's that? You want me to get super drunk without you? I mean...I wasn't going to but, if you insist-
lines.zh: : 你说什么？你想让我在你到之前喝个烂醉？我意思是……我本来没打算，不过既然你坚持——

lines.en: : Haruka-
lines.zh: : Haruka——

lines.en: : Byeeeeee~!
lines.zh: : 拜拜啦~！

lines.en: Well, Haruka seems a bit...livelier than normal today.
lines.zh: 嗯，Haruka 今天看起来比平时……活泼了点。

lines.en: I just hope that she doesn't {i}actually{/i} wind up getting too drunk while I'm on my way over since dealing with her {i}and{/i} Sara that way sounds...hard.
lines.zh: 我只希望在我过去的路上她别{i}真的{/i}喝太醉，因为那样应付她{i}和{/i} Sara 听起来……很难。

lines.en: Maybe I'll try walking a little faster than normal...
lines.zh: 也许我该试着走得比平时快一点……

lines.en: scene black
I take a moment to straighten out my clothes before making my way inside.
lines.zh: 进门前，我先花点时间把衣服整理好。

lines.en: I'm sure no one cares, but it is one of the exceedingly rare opportunities I have to be alone with people actually close to my age and I should at least look the part of a mature human being.
lines.zh: 我知道没人在意，但这是我极其难得的机会——能和真正跟我年纪相仿的人单独待着，我至少该有个成熟人类的样子。

lines.en: Even if my companions for the evening will see me as one giant blur...
lines.zh: 尽管今晚陪我的那两位只会把我看成一团巨大的模糊影子……

lines.en: scene harukabar1
: Heeeeey! You made it! I’m not alone anymore!
lines.zh: : 嘿——！你来啦！我不再是一个人啦！

lines.en: : I’ve been here with you the entire time...
lines.zh: : 我一直都在这儿陪着你啊……

lines.en: : Hey, you two. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们俩。怎么样？

lines.en: I take a seat next to Haruka, whose face has already gone full-blush from drinking.
lines.zh: 我在 Haruka 旁边坐下，她已经因为喝酒满脸通红。

lines.en: Sara is busy wiping down the counter in front of us and, surprisingly enough, doesn't seem drunk at all.
lines.zh: Sara 正忙着擦我们面前的吧台，而且出人意料的是，她看起来一点都没醉。

lines.en: Which I guess means this will, at least for the time being, be a decently lopsided conversation in which we counteract...however Haruka is when she's drunk.
lines.zh: 这大概意味着，至少暂时，这会是一场相当一边倒的对话——我们要用它来对冲……Haruka 喝醉时的那副样子。

lines.en: : How was your walk, man? See anything {i}cool{/i} along the way?
lines.zh: : 你过来这一路怎么样啊，老兄？路上看见什么{i}好玩的{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Maybe like a...{i}huge stick{/i} or something?
lines.zh: : 比如说……{i}一根巨大的棍子{/i}之类的？

lines.en: I immediately understand how Haruka is when she's drunk.
lines.zh: 我立刻明白了 Haruka 喝醉时是什么样子。

lines.en: : It was a normal walk. I didn’t see anything particularly notable.
lines.zh: : 就是很普通的一段路。没看到什么特别值得一提的。

lines.en: : Cool, cool. Normal walk. Got it.
lines.zh: : 酷，酷。很普通的一段路。明白了。

lines.en: : Great icebreaker, Haru-chan.
lines.zh: : 破冰话题真棒，Haru-chan。

lines.en: scene harukabar2
: So...you two are friends? Or...
lines.zh: : 那么……你俩是朋友？还是……

lines.en: : Don’t talk to her, man. She's drunk.
lines.zh: : 别跟她说话，老兄。她喝醉了。

lines.en: scene harukabar3
: I haven’t even had anything to drink yet...
lines.zh: : 我可还一口都没喝呢……

lines.en: : Yeah, Haruka. I’ve seen Sara drunk and she-
lines.zh: : 就是啊，Haruka。我见过 Sara 喝醉的样子，她——

lines.en: : Shhhh...You and me are talking right now. She’s just a bartender. It’s my turn to have you.
lines.zh: : 嘘——现在是你和我在说话。她只是个酒保。这轮该轮到我拥有你了。

lines.en: scene harukabar4
: I...probably should have cut her off after five, huh?
lines.zh: : 我……大概五杯之后就该把她撂下的，是吧？

lines.en: : Haruka, you had five beers in the time it took me to get here?
lines.zh: : Haruka，在我赶过来的这段时间里你就喝了五杯啤酒？

lines.en: : I called you like fifteen minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 我十五分钟前才给你打的电话。

lines.en: : Five? That’s it? Pfft. Gimme five more. I got this.
lines.zh: : 五杯？就这？切。再来五杯。我扛得住。

lines.en: : Sara’s the one who gets drunk off five beers. I can go all night, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 五杯啤酒就醉的是 Sara。我能喝一整晚，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: scene harukabar5
: Oh, wait! I didn’t mean it {i}like that{/i}. Hahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哦，等等！我不是{i}那个意思{/i}。哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : You’re so naughty, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 你真坏，Sensei！

lines.en: : I didn’t even say anything...
lines.zh: : 我什么都没说啊……

lines.en: scene harukabar6
: Oh, you didn’t? Does that mean I'm...{i}imagining things?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，你没有吗？那是不是说明我在……{i}想入非非？……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m so sorry...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我太抱歉了……{/i}

lines.en: Sara whispers across the table as if to say something along the lines of “I had a feeling this might happen” or “I could have prevented this.”
lines.zh: Sara 隔着桌子低声说着什么，像是在表达“我早就知道会这样”或者“我本来可以阻止的”。

lines.en: But the truth is, I really don’t mind.
lines.zh: 但说实话，我真的不介意。

lines.en: Would I have minded if she was a {i}less{/i} horny drunk? Possibly. But this seems like a pretty great turn of events for me.
lines.zh: 如果她是个{i}没那么{/i}色的醉鬼，我会不会介意？也许会。但对我来说，这似乎是相当棒的发展。

lines.en: Besides, Haruka works hard enough as-is. It’s probably nice for her to take a load off like this every once in a while.
lines.zh: 再说，Haruka 平时已经够辛苦了。偶尔这样卸下担子，对她来说大概也不错。

lines.en: : Can I get a beer, Sara?
lines.zh: : 能给我来杯啤酒吗，Sara？

lines.en: scene harukabar7
: Oh, shoot! I forgot to even ask.
lines.zh: : 噢，糟了！我居然忘了问。

lines.en: : I’ll be right back. I just need to grab some from upstairs since Haru-chan finished everything down here.
lines.zh: : 我马上回来。我得上楼去拿，因为楼下的全被 Haru-chan 喝光了。

lines.en: : And...why exactly do you keep the beer in your apartment instead of in the bar?
lines.zh: : 还有……你为什么把啤酒放在自己公寓里，而不是放在酒吧？

lines.en: scene harukabar8
: Cause it's a lot less fun drinking myself to sleep if I have to keep walking downstairs.
lines.zh: : 因为要是还得一直跑下楼，那把自己灌醉了睡觉就没那么有意思了。

lines.en: : Now hang out for just a sec and don’t take advantage of my friend while I’m gone.
lines.zh: : 那你们就待一小会儿，我不在的时候别占我朋友便宜。

lines.en: scene harukabar9
Sara disappears upstairs and, moments later, I can hear her footsteps as she moves through her apartment.
lines.zh: Sara 消失在楼上，片刻之后，我能听见她穿过公寓的脚步声。

lines.en: It makes me realize exactly how old this place must be if I can hear something like that even with the...jazzy piano music playing in the background.
lines.zh: 这让我意识到这地方得有多老——即使背景里放着那首……爵士钢琴曲，我都能听见那种声音。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
: Heheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Hah...heheheh...
lines.zh: : 哈……嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : What’s so funny?
lines.zh: : 有什么好笑的？

lines.en: scene harukabar10
: Heheheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Haruka, explain your-
lines.zh: : Haruka，你给我解释——

lines.en: scene harukabar11
: You two had {i}sex{/i} with each other~
lines.zh: : 你们两个{i}上过床{/i}了~

lines.en: : Yes. That is a thing that happened.
lines.zh: : 是的。确实发生过这么一件事。

lines.en: : You put your penis inside of my friend.
lines.zh: : 你把你的阴茎插进了我朋友里面。

lines.en: : That would be how sex works, yes.
lines.zh: : 性行为本来就是这么运作的，没错。

lines.en: : Did it feel good?
lines.zh: : 感觉爽吗？

lines.en: : It normally does.
lines.zh: : 通常都挺爽的。

lines.en: : You gonna do it again?
lines.zh: : 你还打算再来一次吗？

lines.en: : Why do you ask, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 你为什么问这个，Haruka？

lines.en: : I don’t knooooow...curiosity?
lines.zh: : 我不知——道……好奇不行吗？

lines.en: : Are you looking for an invitation?
lines.zh: : 你是在找邀请吗？

lines.en: scene harukabar12
: Maybe you can just film it and send it to me so I can watch it at home?
lines.zh: : 要不你拍下来发给我，我回家自己看？

lines.en: : I’ll bring it up to Sara next time.
lines.zh: : 下次我会跟 Sara 提的。

lines.en: scene harukabar13
: Dude, I was kidding!
lines.zh: : 老兄，我开玩笑的！

lines.en: : I tooooootally don’t wanna watch you fuck my friend. That's like...{i}so{/i} gross...
lines.zh: : 我可一点都不想看你操我朋友。那也{i}太{/i}……恶心了……

lines.en: : Who’s watching what now?
lines.zh: : 谁在看什么？

lines.en: scene harukabar14
Sara shows back up out of virtually nowhere and winks at me. There’s not a doubt in my mind that she at least heard the tail end of that.
lines.zh: Sara 几乎是从天而降地回来了，还冲我眨了眨眼。我毫不怀疑她至少听到了最后那半句。

lines.en: In other news, though, I think I need to buy a video camera.
lines.zh: 另外还有件事，我觉得我该去买台摄像机了。

lines.en: scene harukabar15
: Shhh. Don’t tell her what we talked about. {i}It’s a secret.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嘘。别告诉她我们聊了什么。{i}这是秘密。{/i}

lines.en: : Is it {i}really{/i} a secret if Sara already told you about us?
lines.zh: : 如果 Sara 已经跟你说了我们俩的事，那{i}还{/i}算什么秘密？

lines.en: : Hm? What about us? What did I tell you, Haru-chan?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我们俩的什么？我跟你说了什么，Haru-chan？

lines.en: : Look! You’re gonna get me in trouble!
lines.zh: : 你看！你要害我挨骂了！

lines.en: : I’m not going to do anything that you weren’t going to do yourself.
lines.zh: : 我不会做你自己本来也打算做的事。

lines.en: else:
scene harukabar16
I can’t help but notice Haruka stare off into the distance as soon as Sara disappears.
lines.zh: 我不可避免地注意到，Sara 一走开，Haruka 就盯着远处出神。

lines.en: She grows rather quiet compared to how she was just moments ago and it’s...actually kind of confusing.
lines.zh: 比起刚才，她安静了不少，而这……说实话挺让人困惑的。

lines.en: I'm assuming that something is bothering her, but it wouldn't be right for me to just-
lines.zh: 我猜是有什么事困扰着她，但我直接问的话不太——

lines.en: : She’s so pretty, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她好漂亮，是不是？

lines.en: Okay. I guess I'm going to find out after all.
lines.zh: 好吧。看来我终究还是会知道的。

lines.en: : Sara?
lines.zh: : Sara？

lines.en: : Mhm.
: I mean...Yeah. She’s attractive. Why?
lines.zh: : 我意思是……是啊。她很有魅力。怎么了？

lines.en: Haruka lets out a heavy sigh, eyes still locked on where her friend stood just moments ago.
lines.zh: Haruka 重重地叹了口气，眼睛仍盯着她朋友刚刚站着的地方。

lines.en: : Why didn’t you have sex with her?
lines.zh: : 你为什么没和她上床？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Didn’t you turn her down when she was basically throwing herself at you? Why?
lines.zh: : 她都基本上是在往你身上贴了，你还拒绝了她。为什么？

lines.en: : Not to be rude, but how does that involve you?
lines.zh: : 不是我无礼，但这跟你有什么关系？

lines.en: scene harukabar17
: It doesn’t...but it’s confusing.
lines.zh: : 没关系……可它让我很困惑。

lines.en: : Sara seemed pretty popular when we were in[school]. She was the kind of girl that everybody just, like...{i}knew.{/i} I was honestly really jealous of her.
lines.zh: : 我们在[school]的时候，Sara 好像挺受欢迎的。她是那种……所有人都{i}认识{/i}的女孩。说实话我特别嫉妒她。

lines.en: : I never even had a boyfriend until I turned 18. And even then...
lines.zh: : 我直到十八岁才交上第一个男朋友。而且就算那时候……

lines.en: scene harukabar18
: Heheh...actually...it’s not like any of {i}my{/i} story involves {i}you{/i}. So I’ll just stop there...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……其实……{i}我的{/i}故事跟{i}你{/i}一点关系都没有。所以我就说到这儿吧……

lines.en: scene harukabar19
: Okay! Supermom has returned!
lines.zh: : 好啦！超级妈妈回来了！

lines.en: : Did you two get along well while I was upstairs? Is anyone pregnant yet?
lines.zh: : 我上楼这会儿你俩相处得还愉快吗？有人怀孕了吗？

lines.en: scene harukabar20
: Yeah. We’re having twins. We need your help choosing names.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们怀了双胞胎。需要你帮忙起名字。

lines.en: scene harukabar21
: How about...Sana and Sara?
lines.zh: : 要不叫……Sana 和 Sara？

lines.en: : That...wouldn't bother you? Because it probably-
lines.zh: : 那……你不会介意吗？因为大概——

lines.en: : Hey. Wait a second.
lines.zh: : 嘿。等一下。

lines.en: : Where is my beer?
lines.zh: : 我的啤酒呢？

lines.en: scene harukabar22
: In the cooler, silly. It needs to get cold.
lines.zh: : 在冷藏箱里呢，傻瓜。得冰一下。

lines.en: : How can you provide such horrible customer service with a smile on your face?
lines.zh: : 你这种笑脸是怎么配得上这么糟糕的服务的？

lines.en: if sarasex == False:
scene harukabar23
: {size=-10}Maybe I'm still a little mad that {i}somebody{/i} rejected me in my time of need?{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-10}也许是因为我还有点生气——{i}有人{/i}在我最需要的时候拒绝了我？{/size}

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene harukabar22
: Hm? I didn’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯？我什么都没说。

lines.en: else:
: Apologies, sir. But you’re just going to have to deal with it. Please don’t cause a scene in front of my other customers.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，先生。不过您只能将就一下了。请别在我的其他客人面前闹事。

lines.en: Right. Forgot about all of her {i}customers{/i}.
lines.zh: 对。忘了她的那些{i}客人{/i}。

lines.en: : Fine. Whatever. I’ll just have some of Haruka’s.
lines.zh: : 行。随便吧。我就喝点 Haruka 的。

lines.en: I go to reach for Haruka’s beer and-
lines.zh: 我伸手去拿 Haruka 的啤酒，然后——

lines.en: scene harukabar24
: Nuh-uh! No you won’t! This one’s all mine. You’re gonna have to wait for your own.
lines.zh: : 不行！你别想！这杯全是我的。你得等你自己那杯。

lines.en: : But that’s your sixth one and I'm stuck at zero for the foreseeable future.
lines.zh: : 可这已经是你的第六杯了，而我短期内还卡在零。

lines.en: : So?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？

lines.en: : So that’s plenty. You’re not planning on driving home, are you?
lines.zh: : 所以已经够多了。你没打算开车回家吧？

lines.en: : I didn't even bring my car. I’m gonna sleep here tonight~
lines.zh: : 我根本没开车来。我今晚要睡在这儿~

lines.en: scene harukabar25
: You are?
lines.zh: : 你要？

lines.en: : {i}You are?{/i}
: Isn't this a thing I should have known about?
lines.zh: : 这种事不是应该提前让我知道吗？

lines.en: : I just decided right now.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚才决定的。

lines.en: : This is the first time I’ve been with {i}two{/i} friends in forever and I want to drink and have more fun.
lines.zh: : 这是我很久以来第一次和{i}两个{/i}朋友在一起，我想喝酒，想更开心一点。

lines.en: scene harukabar26
: Aww...Haru-chan is actually being cute and not just horny and lonely for once! What a rare and wonderful sight.
lines.zh: : 哎呀……Haru-chan 居然真的在犯可爱，而不是只会发情和孤单了！真是罕见又美妙的景象。

lines.en: : I’m in. Let’s all get drunk and talk about our feelings!
lines.zh: : 我加入。咱们都喝醉，然后聊我们的感情！

lines.en: : Yay!~
: Feelings? What are those?
lines.zh: : 感情？那是什么？

lines.en: scene black
Sara runs upstairs for more alcohol and, like you may have guessed, the three of us spend the next couple hours getting drunk and talking about our “feelings.”
lines.zh: Sara 跑上楼去拿更多的酒，正如你可能猜到的，我们三个在接下来的几个小时里喝醉、聊起了“感情”。
